title: Zabaglione
description: A classic dish from Italy, featuring egg yolk, raspberry, white granulated sugar, marsala wine. A practical home-kitchen version with measured step ingredients and clear cooking methods.

steps.instruction: Whisk egg yolks and sugar in a heatproof bowl until pale and thick.
Place the bowl over a pan of barely simmering water; whisk in Marsala continuously until the custard is airy and thick, cooking the egg mixture thoroughly.
Serve the warm zabaglione immediately with the berries.
